'''Mandrith''' guards the [[Resource Area]] in the deep [[Wilderness]]. He allows players to enter the arena for a fee of 7,500 coins. However, players will only need to pay 6,000 coins to enter if they have completed the medium [[Wilderness Diary]], 3,750 coins if they have completed the hard Wilderness Diary, and can enter free of charge if they have completed the elite Wilderness Diary.

==Treasure Trails==
{{Anagram|Mandrith|elite|[[Clue scroll (elite) - DR HITMAN|DR HITMAN]]}}. The answer to the challenge scroll is '''28'''.<br/>
{{Anagram|Mandrith|master|DIM THARN}}. He will give the player a [[puzzle box]] or a [[light box]].

No fee is required to complete Mandrith's clue steps, he stands outside the gate.

==Trivia==
* Mandrith was originally added in ''RuneScape 2'' in December 2007. He was originally added to host the original iteration of [[Bounty Hunter]], and was later given the ability to buy [[ancient artefacts]] from players similar to how the [[Emblem Trader]] does in ''Old School RuneScape''. The [[artefacts]] found next to him in ''Old School RuneScape'' is a reference to this.
** In ''RuneScape 3'' in 2019, he was also made a [[Slayer Master]].
